findings.rule: Number the figures consecutively with Arabic numerals (for example “Figure 3”), in the order of their appearance in the text.
findings.problem: Figure 4 is cited before Figure 3 in the Results section ('...clockwise direction (Figure 4).' appears before '...(Figure 3) identifies six contacts...'), violating the requirement to number figures consecutively based on their appearance order.

findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: The manuscript lists 12 references, but only cites references [1], [2], [4], and [8] in the main text. References [3], [5], [6], [7], [9], [10], [11], and [12] are not cited anywhere, violating the sequential numbering rule.
